<h2>Validate Manuscript Plot Data</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Enforces common figure-data requirements before a manuscript figure is
drawn or its auditable plot-data table is written.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>validate_manuscript_plot_data(
  data_plot,
  required_columns,
  numeric_bounds = base::list(),
  allow_empty = FALSE
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_plot">data_plot</code></td>
<td>
<p>Data frame to validate.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="required_columns">required_columns</code></td>
<td>
<p>Character vector of required column names.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="numeric_bounds">numeric_bounds</code></td>
<td>
<p>Named list. Each element must be a numeric vector of
length two giving inclusive lower and upper bounds for the named column.
Infinite bounds are permitted.
Missing values are allowed, but non-missing values must be finite and
inside the declared bounds.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="allow_empty">allow_empty</code></td>
<td>
<p>Logical scalar. If 'FALSE', zero-row data are rejected.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>The validated data frame, invisibly.
</p>

</main>
